s.note: Warm gruyere puffs, black pepper, thyme. Estelle shows the house by candlelight.
s.how: Bring the water, milk, butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, tip in the flour and beat over the heat until it forms a smooth ball. Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy. Beat in 100g of the gruyere, the mustard, thyme and plenty of pepper. Pipe walnut-sized balls onto lined trays and top with the rest of the cheese. Bake at 200C until puffed, deep golden and crisp, and serve warm.

s.n: Short-line farm vegetables with green goddess
s.note: Baby vegetables, whipped ricotta, herb dressing. Anna was on the short line once.
s.how: Blanch the asparagus and snap peas for 1 minute, then plunge into iced water. Trim and halve the carrots and radishes, and split the cos into spears. Whip the ricotta with lemon zest, a pinch of salt and a splash of oil until smooth. Blitz the mayo, sour cream, herbs and vinegar until pale green. Spread the ricotta on a board, pile on the vegetables and serve the dressing alongside.

m.note: The turkey shoots out of the oven. Turkey breast, sourdough stuffing, gravy.
m.how: Mash half the butter with the herbs and lemon zest and push it under the turkey skin. Season well. Roast at 180C, basting twice, until the thickest part reaches 70C, then rest under foil. Meanwhile soften the onion and celery in the rest of the butter, toss with the bread, cranberries, egg and 200ml stock, and bake in a dish alongside the turkey for 40 minutes. Stir the flour into the pan juices over the heat, whisk in the rest of the stock and simmer to a gravy. Slice the turkey and serve with the stuffing and gravy.

w.note: Fallen flourless chocolate cake, cream, raspberries. The staircase comes down under Walter.
w.how: Melt the chocolate and butter together and cool slightly. Beat the yolks with half the sugar until pale, then stir in the chocolate and the cocoa. Whisk the whites to soft peaks, whisk in the rest of the sugar, then fold into the chocolate. Bake in a lined 22cm springform at 170C until risen and just set. It will crack and sink as it cools. Fill the crater with whipped cream, scatter raspberries and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Gin, lemon, sugar and soda, poured tall. The bathtub goes through the floor.
d.how: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool. Shake the gin, lemon juice and syrup hard with ice. Strain into 4 tall glasses of ice, top with soda and add a lemon slice.
